supporting_evidence: RF1 traditional tofu failure contains tofu-curd, cloth-lined mold, pressing apparatus and canonical tofu-workshop process schema.
Historical tofu outputs repeatedly show explanatory staging around tofu-process objects.
counterevidence: RF3 contemporary tofu preserves tofu topic, same pressing instant, same freshly transferred curds, same cloth-lined wooden mold and same core process state, yet passes all four Golden realism gates.
residual_hypotheses.updated_falsifiable_claim: Tofu process-object semantics alone are not sufficient. They may still interact with heritage framing or another topic-conditioned factor.

supporting_evidence: RF1 failures repeatedly exhibit wet surfaces, haze/steam and coherent atmospheric craft cues.
counterevidence: RF3 did not add any prohibition on steam, wet floor, haze or cinematic light and preserved the same pressing-stage semantics, yet passes all four Golden gates.
residual_hypotheses.updated_falsifiable_claim: Moisture/steam semantics alone are not sufficient. Interaction with heritage framing remains possible, but a clean direct manipulation is difficult without changing phase/action/object state.

supporting_evidence: RF1 traditional tofu FAIL versus RF3 contemporary tofu PASS under an intended one-slot heritage semantic intervention.
RF3 therefore establishes that heritage framing matters in the tofu context.
counterevidence: No matched non-tofu pair currently varies only heritage framing.
RF2 rice PASS cannot serve as a strict heritage baseline because the exact generation prompt identity was not frozen/retained in the repository.
residual_hypotheses.updated_falsifiable_claim: Unresolved whether heritage has a cross-topic main effect or whether the effect is specific to heritage×tofu interaction.

supporting_evidence: RF1, RF2 and RF3 all use closely related minimal documentary task scaffolding.
counterevidence: The same RF1 shared task structure is present in RF1 FAIL and RF3 PASS, so it cannot by itself be sufficient for failure.
RF2 also passes under the shared structural family.
residual_hypotheses.updated_falsifiable_claim: Shared task structure alone is not sufficient; any residual role must be an interaction with topic/heritage semantics.

supporting_evidence: Repeated traditional-tofu failures show stable renderer tendencies toward staging and photogenic craft cues.
counterevidence: RF2 rice and RF3 contemporary tofu both pass Golden absolute realism under the same ChatGPT Images renderer.
residual_hypotheses.updated_falsifiable_claim: A universal renderer-failure explanation is contradicted. Conditional renderer priors may still mediate heritage/topic interactions.

information_gain_priority.question: HERITAGE_MAIN_EFFECT_VS_HERITAGE_X_TOFU_INTERACTION
information_gain_priority.reason: Directly separates the strongest remaining causal ambiguity created by RF3.

information_gain_priority.question: TOFU_PROCESS_OBJECT_X_HERITAGE_INTERACTION
information_gain_priority.reason: Still plausible, but clean object-schema intervention would change object identity/content and is harder to keep single-variable.

information_gain_priority.question: MOISTURE_STEAM_X_HERITAGE_INTERACTION
information_gain_priority.reason: Plausible but direct manipulation risks changing process phase, action or object state; prior S3 design was already rejected for this confound.

information_gain_priority.question: SHARED_TASK_STRUCTURE_INTERACTION
information_gain_priority.reason: Task structure is already shown not sufficient by itself; factorial interaction testing would cost more and deliver less immediate information.

one_image_reuse_RF2_rice.reason: RF2 rice execution receipt preserves asset identity and high-level treatment metadata but not an exact frozen generator prompt identity. A new contemporary-rice image compared against that historical asset would therefore differ in an unknown prompt dimension in addition to heritage semantics.

tofu_process_object_one_image.reason: Changing tofu process-object identity while preserving the exact production instant/object set is logically incompatible with the variable itself; action/object semantics would co-change.

moisture_one_image.reason: Any natural change large enough to alter moisture/steam while preserving tofu identity risks changing process phase/action/object state. Explicit negative rules are prohibited and would also confound the task.

heritage_non_tofu_matched_pair.reason: Create a fresh matched non-tofu pair from one frozen template differing only in WORKSHOP_SEMANTIC_SLOT. Both arms share topic, event, object set, renderer, aspect, no-R1C policy, task structure and Golden gate.

frozen_next_experiment_contract.causal_question: Does heritage/traditional framing have a cross-topic main effect, or is the RF3 effect more consistent with heritage×tofu interaction?
frozen_next_experiment_contract.rationale_for_topic: Rice is the strongest existing non-tofu control family because RF2 and historical rice evidence already show that this topic can produce credible imagery under ChatGPT Images.
frozen_next_experiment_contract.core_object_set: same sieve, rice/grain, receiving sack/container, same immediate processing station
fixed: same exact object inventory and object state
same RF1-style minimal documentary task structure
frozen_next_experiment_contract.pair_integrity_rule: Both prompts must be frozen from one template before generation and must differ only in WORKSHOP_SEMANTIC_SLOT. Any other textual or control-plane difference invalidates the causal experiment.
frozen_next_experiment_contract.why_not_one_image: The historical RF2 rice asset lacks an exact frozen prompt identity, so using it as one matched arm would introduce an unmeasured prompt confound.

A_TRADITIONAL_FAIL__B_CONTEMPORARY_PASS.allowed_claim: Heritage/traditional framing shows a directional realism penalty outside tofu under a matched pair.
prohibited_claims: heritage is the unique root cause

A_TRADITIONAL_PASS__B_CONTEMPORARY_PASS.allowed_claim: The RF3 effect does not generalize as a simple heritage main effect in this matched rice pair.
prohibited_claims: heritage×tofu interaction is proven sole cause
heritage has zero effect in all contexts

A_TRADITIONAL_FAIL__B_CONTEMPORARY_FAIL.allowed_claim: Both arms fail; the pair does not identify a heritage effect.

stop_conditions: This RF4 audit itself authorizes zero images.
Future matched-pair experiment, if separately authorized, stops after exactly two valid images and one Golden absolute evaluation.
No retry, reroll, replacement, best-of-N or third image.
If either arm is technically invalid, stop the contract without replacement.
Do not add rules after seeing output quality.
Do not reuse RF2 or RF3 cancelled/consumed image budget.
